title: Capacity Mission Control: scaling timeline, operator controls and throughput insights
creator: Liam Chen
description:
Problem: Operators need a single view in Console that combines live and historical throughput, recent scaling actions, and a compact set of controls for manual overrides and policy tuning. Current Console surfaces are fragmented across the Fleet -> Scaling -> Audit tabs and don't provide an actionable timeline or easy rollback for canary/reserved scaling changes.

Goal: Ship a Capacity Mission Control panel in Console that: (1) shows a unified time-series of throughput, latency P50/P95, GPU util and active agents; (2) surfaces a chronological changelog of scaling actions with operator annotations; (3) exposes lightweight scaling controls (target QPS, reserve pool adjustments, temporary headroom toggles) with guardrails; (4) integrates with rollout policies so changes can be applied as canary or global; (5) provides bias-free cost delta estimates before applying changes.

Why now: Dedicated customers increasingly request predictable throughput guarantees and a clear audit trail for scaling decisions. This feature reduces operational ticket volume, shortens incident MTTI, and enables non-SRE operators to manage capacity safely.
acceptance_criteria: Mission Control panel available under Fleet > <fleet-name> > Mission Control
Time-series chart includes throughput (QPS), served tokens/s, P50/P95 latency and GPU util selectable by time range (1h/6h/24h/7d)
Changelog lists all autoscale/manual/rollback events in the selected window with timestamp, initiator (human or policy), diff summary, and link to related PR/incident when present
Scaling controls allow: set target throughput, enable temporary headroom (+% or fixed), select rollout mode (canary/global), preview estimated cost delta and expected latency impact before committing
All operator actions create an auditable event persisted to the audit log and trigger a webhook to the ops stream
Feature toggled behind console-2025.03 release flag and accessible only to users with fleet:manage role
success_metrics: Reduce dedicated-capacity escalation tickets by 30% in first 90 days
Decrease mean time to scale manual actions from 18 minutes to under 7 minutes
>85% of applied manual scaling actions use the preview cost delta (indicating operator trust)
No critical security or compliance regressions in Private deployments during rollout
notes:
Trade-offs considered: exposed only a small set of manual controls to avoid duplicating autoscaler logic. We opted for a simulated preview of cost and latency impact using the weekly job that models batch sizes and kernel mix instead of a realtime estimator to avoid adding weight to the serving control plane.

Open questions: exact guardrail math for headroom (% vs fixed GPUs) and RBAC role granularity. Need legal signoff on retention period for operator annotations in audit log for Private customers.

implementation_plan: Phase 1 (MVP): Mission Control UI + read-only unified chart + changelog + preview cost delta. Phase 2: Writable scaling controls, canary rollout integration, annotations and rollback UX. Phase 3: advanced telemetry (P50/P95 overlays), policy-driven suggestions and saved views.
qa_notes: Create a set of synthetic load tests that exercise autoscaler + manual override concurrently. Verify audit events exist for each manual action and webhook payload schema. Regression test for console role gating and feature flag behavior.
rollout_plan: 1) Internal dogfood on staging; 2) Beta with 3 pilot customers on Dedicated (invite-only); 3) Gradual ramp to 10% of orgs with telemetry monitoring for errors/latency; 4) Full public release in console-2025.03 when telemetry stable and security signoff complete
